messages:
Maya: quick thread to lock the benchmark landing creative + routing. goal: a single hero chart, 3 micro-demos, and clear lead signals for SDR vs nurture. deadline EOD tomorrow.
Noah: for hero chart i prototyped an interactive scatter where hover reveals sample workloads (chat, summary, embeddings). can export a static fallback for press. thinking axes: x = p50 latency (ms), y = $/1k tokens, point size = tokens/sec throughput.
Asha: love the interactive idea. one ask: make sure the static hero highlights two badges: \"SLA-grade\" and \"Cost-optimized\" so we don't lose the positioning without interactivity.
Liam: demos: 1) live chat (sub-second feels), 2) nightly batch embeddings (high throughput), 3) fallback to quantized model when Dedicated is saturated. each demo should map to a callout on the hero chart so viewers can connect visual -> action.
Maya: agree. Noah can you create two CTA variants to A/B test? Variant A: `See your latency & cost` Variant B: `Run a quick benchmark`
Noah: yep. my hypothesis: A wins with clarity, B wins with conversion for devs who like action. we'll embed experiment id in `utm_campaign`.
Asha: routing rules proposal: define high-intent if any of these happen: (a) clicks pricing from hero, (b) requests demo, (c) fill form and selects `deployment_preference = Dedicated` or `Private`. send high-intent to SDR_Stream_1. everything else -> nurture drip.
Maya: add `expected_monthly_tokens` + `sla_requirement` (string: low/medium/high) to form metadata. these are crucial for segmenting Dedicated vs Hosted conversations.
Liam: also capture `use_case` free text — helps SDRs prep. we'll surface it in CRM lead notes.
analytics-bot: FYI: make sure experiment key `bench_launch_v2` is present and that analytics events fire: `hero_view`, `hero_hover`, `cta_click`, `form_submit`.
Noah: on visuals: i'll produce 3 outputs: 1) hero interactive (iframe), 2) static PNG for landing, 3) simplified SVG for social cards. aesthetic: bold gridlines, two color lanes (fast/cost), subtle texture for private deployment points.
Asha: copy notes for the callouts: - Fast lane: \"<250ms median — built for real-time apps\" - Cost lane: \"Lowest $/token for high-volume workloads\" - Legal microcopy: \"Results are illustrative; performance may vary by prompt, seq length, and infra.\"
Maya: demo recording plan: Liam to record 3 x 60s clips. keep them raw so we can repurpose for reels. also capture terminal logs for a short DevX clip showing latency numbers.
Liam: i'll schedule block at 2pm. will simulate traffic for the batch embedding clip.
Noah: one more ask: include a small inline table under the hero showing 3 example slices: Chat Support, Document Search, Batch Embeddings with median latency and cost numbers. keeps messaging concrete.
Asha: good idea. numbers should be rounded and include a range: e.g., Chat Support — 120-300ms, $0.30-$0.90 per 1k.
Maya: okay owners: Noah = charts + CTAs + exportables (due tomorrow noon), Asha = landing microcopy + form fields + legal line (due tomorrow 10am), Liam = demo recordings (due tomorrow 5pm), Maya = landing assembly + experiment wiring (due tomorrow EOD).
analytics-bot: Reminder: set `data-layer.pageType = \"benchmark_landing\"` and add `user_consent` gating for EU visitors.
Noah: uploading first interactive build in ~90m. will include sample JSON for hover payloads.
Asha: i'll draft the nurture email sequences targeted by `sla_requirement` and `expected_monthly_tokens` after lunch and post to #content-review.
Liam: recording note: for the fallback demo, show the UI switching to a quantized variant with a toast: `Fallback to cost-optimized model — latency may increase`. keeps expectations honest.
Maya: perfect. final marketing question: show price ranges on the landing or hide behind CTA? pros/cons?
Asha: show a small starting price range (e.g., \"$X–$Y / 1k tokens\") but hide detailed pricing behind the pricing modal to avoid scaring enterprise leads.
Maya: excellent. closing the loop — will ping when assets land. please keep comments short in this thread. :seedling:
